outcomes: WRITING- Students will be able to write detailed and well organized letters, essays, or reports on a range of topics, in Spanish, at an intermediate proficiency level with minimal errors in grammar, spelling, and mechanics.
SPEAKING -Students will be able to actively participate in conversations and discussions, in Spanish, with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes interaction with Spanish-speakers possible.
READING-Students will be able to read critically about literary texts, articles and reports produced in Spanish.

LISTENING- Students will be able to recognize the linguistic variations that exists within the Spanish-speaking world and understand the main points in conversations, radio, television programs, and film.

notes: The catalog prints course codes without a space (e.g. 'SPAN101'); recorded here with a space between subject and number to match the closed list. The Award Instructions list also writes 'ENG 172'/'ENG 173' while the requirements table prints ENGL172/ENGL173.

The outer 'REQUIRED COURSES (10 - 20 units)' heading shows '(Total 20)' / 'Complete the following number of credits: 20', but the description lays out two paths: non-native learners take SPAN 101, 102, 103, 110 plus one List A course; native/heritage learners take SPAN 109 and 110 plus List A electives to reach the minimum. The eLumen structure (SPAN 101+102 all; choose 5 units of SPAN 109 or SPAN 103; SPAN 110) does not cleanly encode these paths; reviewer should check.

A '3 - 6' unit figure is printed beside the substitution-courses note just before List A, while List A itself shows '(Total 3)'; recorded stated as 3. Placement out of core courses without units requires additional List A units to reach 18 units in the major.
The catalog recommends SPAN 112 or SPAN 173 as the List A choice; these are within the required List A choice, so no separate recommended block was created.

The text begins mid-sentence (cut off) and contains a stray repeated lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' followed by 'SPANISH, AA-T *' before the actual Program Learning Outcomes heading.

Degree summary: 19-23 major units, 6-12 double-counted, 34 Cal-GETC units, 9-13 CSU-transferable elective units, 60 total; the elective units belong to the degree, not the major, so open_elective_units is null.
